title: Fuel-bounded vertex unfolding
statement: Given a natural number $n$, a list of gates, a fuel bound, a vertex $v$, and a polarity $p$, unfold the vertex recursively as follows. With zero fuel, return an empty AND node. With positive fuel, if $v<n$, return the literal at variable $v$ with polarity $p$; otherwise unfold the gate at index $v-n$, using an empty AND gate if that index is outside the list, and recursively unfold its argument vertices with one less unit of fuel.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $n$ of input variables
